source.title: Call for Applicants - WAC Leader (August 2024)
source.content:
There will be an appointment of a new WCA Appeals Committee Leader.


Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months).  The work commitment is expected to be sporadic, with some weeks of intense activity and some of little to no activity. The range is expected to be 1 - 5 hours per week.


Mandatory requirements:

- Candidates must have served a period of at least 12 consecutive months as a member of WCA Staff.
- Candidates must not be a serving member of the WCA Board, the WCA Regulations Committee, or the WCA Integrity Committee (or must be willing to relinquish the role upon appointment to this role).


The qualities expected of candidates are:

- Excellent knowledge and comprehension of the the WCA Motions, Regulations, policies and governance documents
- Strong leadership skills
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- An ability to be unbiased with a strong commitment to fairness
<!-- break -->

The application period for candidates to submit their candidacy documents is from **now until August 21th, 2024, 23:59 UTC.** Interested candidates can send the application privately to the Executive Assistant Team (assistants@worldcubeassociation.org), CC’ing the WCA Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org).


The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

- Brief personal introduction.
- Summary of activities done for the WCA.
- Ambitions as the Leader of the WCA Appeals Committee.


Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WCA Appeals Committee can be found in [WCA Motion 10.2024.4](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2024.4%20-%20Appeals%20Committee.pdf).

After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, as described in Section 5 of [WCA Motion 10.2024.0](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2024.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf). 

Please note that the WCA Board have appointed Stone Amsbaugh as an interim Leader for a period of up to 3 months, expiring November 7th, 2024. 

Thanks for your candidacies and support.

translation.title: WCA 申诉委员会招募负责人（2024 年 8 月）
translation.content:
WCA 将任命一位新的申诉委员会负责人。

申请人应能完成 24 个月任期。工作量预计并不均匀，有些星期较忙，有些星期几乎或完全没有工作，预计每周约需 1–5 小时。

必须满足的条件：

- 曾连续担任 WCA 工作人员至少 12 个月。
- 目前不得是 WCA 董事会、规则委员会或廉政委员会成员；若担任上述职务，须愿意在获任本岗位后辞去原职。

我们希望申请人具备：

- 深入了解 WCA 议案、竞赛规则、政策和治理文件。
- 出色的领导能力。
- 出色的书面及口头沟通能力。
- 能够不偏不倚地处理事务，坚持公平原则。
<!-- break -->

申请从即日起开放，**截止时间为 2024 年 8 月 21 日 23:59 UTC**。有意者请私下将材料发送至董事会助理团队（assistants@worldcubeassociation.org），并抄送 WCA 董事会（board@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，包含：

- 简短的个人介绍。
- 为 WCA 所做工作的概述。
- 担任 WCA 申诉委员会负责人的工作设想。

另请提供一份可在申请截止后公开的申请材料副本。

WCA 申诉委员会的权利与职责见 [WCA 议案 10.2024.4](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2024.4%20-%20Appeals%20Committee.pdf)。

申请截止后，WCA 董事会将按照 [WCA 议案 10.2024.0](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2024.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf) 第 5 节，通过投票选出并公布新负责人。

请注意，WCA 董事会已任命 Stone Amsbaugh 为代理负责人，任期最长 3 个月，于 2024 年 11 月 7 日届满。

感谢大家的申请与支持。
